about: Labeled conversations for memory_evals::live_extraction. Each expect item is satisfied when one proposal body contains every term in `all` (case-insensitive). A proposal that contains a `forbid` phrase is a forbidden proposal. `pins` are already active before the run. `appEvents` are app.event entries (hidden, as apps/events.rs writes them) added after the messages; the digest shows only those of apps that are on and declare a memory scope.
